text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to see and understand the world through images and videos. At its core, it involves two main tasks: image recognition, which identifies what is in a picture, and object detection, which locates specific items within a scene. These technologies have many practical applications in daily life. For example, social media platforms use them to tag friends in photos, and smartphones use them to unlock your device by scanning your face. Perhaps the most exciting use is in self-driving cars, where cameras and computer vision systems detect pedestrians, traffic lights, and other vehicles in real time to make safe driving decisions. As this technology advances, it will continue to shape how we interact with machines.
